h1: Bain Marie Food Warmer with 8 Pans
short_description: Keep your whole menu hot, moist and ready to serve for hours. This bain marie food warmer holds eight lidded pans over a heated water bath, so rice, stews and greens stay at serving temperature without drying out or burning. sections.heading: Key Features and Benefits
sections.body:
Eight pans in two rows. Hold a full menu in one unit, so customers see plenty of choice and staff serve faster.

Lidded pans with spoon cut-outs. Food stays covered and moist between servings, and serving spoons stay in place, which keeps the counter tidy.

sections.heading: Who It Suits and Where It Is Used

It suits hotel buffets and breakfast service, staff canteens and school dining halls, hospital food service, restaurants with a self-service counter, and caterers serving at events.

Because it rolls on wheels, it is also handy for hotels that serve breakfast in one room and lunch in another, or for conference venues that change their layout from day to day.

sections.heading: How a Bain Marie Works
sections.body:
Water in the well under the pans is heated by an element controlled by the thermostat. The hot water surrounds the base of each pan and transfers heat evenly and gently. Because the heat is moist, food does not form a hard crust and keeps its texture for longer during a long service.

A bain marie is designed to hold food that is already cooked at a safe serving temperature, not to cook raw food.

sections.heading: What to Check Before Buying
sections.body: Count the dishes you serve at one time and choose the number of pans to match. Check your power supply and the route from the kitchen to the serving point if you plan to move the unit on its wheels. Make sure doorways are wide enough.

sections.heading: Tips for Food Safety
sections.body: Always fill the water well before switching on, and never let it run dry. Put food in already hot, straight from the stove, and keep lids on between servings. Stir pans from time to time so the top stays as hot as the bottom, and replace pans with fresh food rather than topping up old food.

sections.heading: Care and Maintenance
sections.body: Switch off and let the water cool before draining. Wash pans and lids after each service and wipe the well to prevent scale building up. Lock the wheels when the unit is in use and clean the castors regularly.
